profile.headline: Software Engineer | Agentic Systems & LLM Infrastructure | Building Reliable AI at Scale
profile.summary:
I'm an engineer focused on building agentic systems and LLM infrastructure that operate reliably at scale.

Over 15+ years, I've worked across backend systems, distributed infrastructure, and AI-powered products. At Uber, I own the agent runtime behind the central agentic support platform — over 10M monthly interactions across Rides, Eats, and Delivery — including cross-vendor LLM failover, session lifecycle, and the systems that track latency and LLM spend. Before that, I led a GenAI chat migration, expanded automation to deliver $30M+ in business impact and spent years modernizing backend services and APIs at global scale.

I enjoy solving hard infrastructure problems: turning emerging technology into dependable systems, and building platforms that let other engineers move faster.

I'm currently interested in Senior and Staff-level opportunities in AI infrastructure, AI platforms, and backend engineering.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Currently tech lead for Nova's Platform area — Uber's central agentic support platform, the agent runtime behind 10M+ monthly support interactions across Rides, Eats, and Delivery.
• Shipped cross-vendor LLM failover as circuit-breaker shared library adopted by multiple agentic systems across Uber
• Re-architected the session state lifecycle and persistence for Nova affecting millions of sessions a month
• Built the system of record for Uber's LLM spend for all of Customer Support function

Earlier at Uber:
• Led the migration of automation for Eats and Delivery Support from Dialogflow to GenAI through phased rollouts
• Expanded automation coverage across Eats and Delivery through deep collaboration with Product, Data Science and Ops to deliver over $30M+ business impact
• Built the core Chat Platform (millions of interactions/month) and Session Context Management
• Modernized legacy API gateways (99.5%→99.95% uptime) and migrated Python monoliths to Go microservices
